sql: /* Query 6: filter3_agg1_join2 (player, team, city, manager) */ SELECT player.position, AVG(player.age) AS avg_player_age FROM player JOIN team ON player.team = team.team_name JOIN manager ON team.ownership = manager.name JOIN city ON team.location = city.city_name WHERE player.nba_championships <= 2 OR player.mvp_awards < 1 GROUP BY player.position

age.description: age of the player (if death_date is given, compute as death_date - birth_date; otherwise, compute as 2025/1/1 - birth_date).

position.description: player's primary position on the team; choose one from ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'].
